recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. If ClinicalAssessment is restored to the active build in the future, retain the existing SOAP note sentence rather than reverting to the older Weed SOAP wording.
issue_request: FHIR-19282 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for ClinicalImpression, raised in STU3 and applied for R5, asking to replace the confusing "A" in Weed SOAP wording with a sentence identifying the A as assessment in the SOAP note format originally described by Lawrence Weed, MD.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites commit b49a4ed40ab67993992fc0877005234b145f07a9. That commit changed source/clinicalimpression/clinicalimpression-introduction.xml from "the \"A\" in Weed SOAP" to the requested SOAP note sentence, and the current legacy ClinicalImpression source still contains that clarified wording.
additional_context: FHIR-46596 later renamed ClinicalImpression to ClinicalAssessment for R6, and commit 670d3a407a962cdde0ef1136fbcdea045b124f19 carried the same clarified SOAP note sentence into the ClinicalAssessment source. Commit fad1b9cf84ef652e88947e1a13b026c62f95334e later removed ClinicalAssessment from active fhir.ini build-scope entries, so neither ClinicalImpression nor ClinicalAssessment is currently active in this checkout. Patient Care Confluence minutes on 2019-01-10 list GF#19282 among discussed ClinicalImpression changes, and Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The requested wording is already present in the historical ClinicalImpression source, preserved in the renamed ClinicalAssessment source, and the target resource is not part of the current active build configuration.
